name: media
description: /playvideo <link> plays a video on a brick screen (its music on a speaker device); /playaudio <link> builds a self-playing synth speaker device with heightmap2brz; /playaudio <sound> plays a built-in game sound; /stop ends yours.
author: pooper

max-minutes.description: Longest video or song that will be played

video-max-minutes.description: Longest video /playvideo will play (frames stream, soundtrack is built in chunks)

audio-chunk-minutes.description: Long video soundtracks are built and swapped in chunks this long

merge-tolerance.description: Video pixels whose colours differ by at most this (0-255 per channel) merge into one brick; higher = fewer bricks and less lag, blockier picture (0 = exact)

max-width.description: Widest video screen in pixels (1 stud each)

bricks-per-second.description: Most bricks per second the video sends to the server; lower it if the server lags

color-step.description: Colour rounding for video pixels (bigger = fewer bricks, more banding)

layers.description: 1 = every frame in the same place (brief flash between frames); 2 = two alternating layers 2 units apart (no flash, the picture steps back and forth)

keep-last-frame.description: Leave the last frame up when a video ends

audio-range.description: How far (game units, 10 per stud) speakers can be heard; the game caps this at 400

synth.description: Synth the MIDI notes play on: sine, square, saw or triangle

synth-base-hz.description: Pitch of the synth sound at pitch 1.0; tune this if songs sound transposed

voices.description: Speakers in a song device (voice mode) / notes at once per instrument (midi mode)

width.description: Default video width in pixels (1 stud each)

pixel-size.description: Video pixel size in units (micro bricks; 10 units = 1 stud, even numbers)

video-chunk-seconds.description: /playvideo builds its wire-prop video and speech soundtrack in pieces this long, swapped while playing

video-audio.description: /playvideo soundtrack when no preset word is given: default (heightmap2brz defaults, bank mode), layered, single, speech, music, drums or mix

audio-fps.description: Audio analysis frames per second for /playaudio links (higher = finer detail)

proxy.description: Force one proxy for downloads (yt-dlp --proxy), e.g. socks5://user:pass@host:1080. Empty = direct, switching to free GitHub proxies while YouTube bot-checks the server

proxy-lists.description: Free proxy lists (space separated URLs, one ip:port or scheme://ip:port per line) tried while YouTube bot-checks the server

commands.name: /playvideo
commands.description: Play a video on a brick screen next to you

args.name: link
args.description: video link (YouTube and most sites) or 'stop'

commands.name: /search
commands.description: Search YouTube and play the first result on a video screen next to you

commands.name: /playaudio
commands.description: Play a song link (YouTube etc. or .mid) on a self-playing speaker device above you, or a built-in sound

args.name: sound
args.description: a link, built-in sound name words, or 'list [word]'. Links take [voice|bank|midi] (voice = tracks pitches, bank = one speaker per note, good for speech, midi = transcribe to notes first) and [sine|square|saw|triangle]

commands.name: /stop
commands.description: Stop your video and audio; with nothing playing it clears leftover screens/speakers (host: /stop all). /stopmedia does the same.
